expect.note: the observation may not advertise a name the resolver can never match

provenance: found while designing the M2 shop fixture (2026-08-16). Chromium's accessibility snapshot reports <dd aria-label="Warranty"> as role 'definition' with name 'Warranty', but ARIA marks term/definition as name-prohibited, so Playwright's accessible-name computation yields '' and get_by_role('definition', name='Warranty') matches 0 elements — verified directly against Playwright 1.49. The planner is told to target only what the observation shows, so it will confidently emit an unresolvable target and the run dies as failure:locate on an element that is right there on the page.

triage.note: observation/resolver capability mismatch — observe() advertises addressability it does not have. Fix = blank the name on name-prohibited roles so the planner cannot target them by name; the residual gap (such values are unaddressable) goes to the support matrix as a stated limitation, not a silent failure.
